fixes.new:
A woman warrior tasked with policing the psychics of planet Gishin.
Recognized for her powerful psychic abilities and loyalty to $$ズール$$, she became one of Wahl's direct subordinates.
She was assigned as adjutant to the mind-controlled Marg, but her post doubled as that of his watcher.
After Marg, whom she had regarded only as someone to watch, saved her life, the compassion and kindness she had sealed deep in her heart began to surface. That respite was brief, though, as Marg's death made conflict with $$タケル$$ unavoidable. Yet through their battles she came to know $$タケル$$'s heart, and after experiencing the kindness of his adoptive mother $$静子$$ and reuniting with her younger sister Rui, she finally resolved to leave $$ズール$$'s side.
From then on, she volunteered to join the Crusher Team, and became a great force in the fight to defeat $$ズール$$.
For a time she returned to planet Gishin, but when $$ズール$$ made his return, she visited Earth to sound the alarm. There, she learned the secret of $$タケル$$'s suffering under the Devil Ring, and continued to worry for him ever since.
In the true final battle with $$ズール$$ on Earth, she confessed her love to a suffering $$タケル$$ and offered up her prayers.
After $$ズール$$ fell, she and $$タケル$$ joined hands and set off together for the galaxy.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says 妹のルイ (Roze's younger sister, brief: 'has a younger sister Rui'), not Takeru's sister; 'his sister' wrongly gave Takeru a sister

fixes.new:
The youngest member of the Crusher Team. Age 10.
Having lost both his parents to a Gishin attack, he asked to enlist in order to avenge them. He initially joined Battle Camp working in the mess hall, through his connection with $$タケル$$. Later, when the team headed into space, he went so far as to board the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ in place of $$タケル$$, who fought aboard Gaia.
Despite his unfortunate circumstances, his personality was extremely bright and positive. He tended to speak his mind the moment she thought it, which often led to inappropriate remarks, but his natural cheer and likability made him the team's mascot, easing the mood wherever he went.
He later began showing signs of psychic ability.
fixes.reason: pronoun: researched gender is male (少年 who admires Takeru) but the English used she/her throughout; also addition: 'of her own' is not in 後に超能力者としての兆しを見せた

fixes.new:
$$タケル$$'s identical twin older brother. Age 17.
He was separated from his brother soon after birth, his father was executed, and he even lost his mother at age 10. Upon learning that $$ズール$$ was behind all of it, he resolved on revenge.
Feigning a loss of sanity to get close to $$ズール$$, he resisted him through an information war, telepathically passing the secret of $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and news of attacks from planet Gishin to $$タケル$$.
Eventually, when Wahl and Sagoul exposed his activities, a bomb was planted on him and he was forced into battle against $$タケル$$. Seizing an opening to break free, he finally reunited with $$タケル$$ and succeeded in passing on their memories of their late parents. But just when it seemed the brothers could finally fight side by side, he was captured by $$ズール$$ and placed under mind control. Forced into a fratricidal battle he never wanted, Marg regained his memories after taking a hard blow to the head in the fighting. This time the brothers truly seemed able to join hands, but Marg stepped in front of a combat mecha to stop $$ロゼ$$, who kept attacking, and was struck by its beam.
He closed out his short life at his brother's side, having never been able to fight alongside him to the end. Yet his resolve to fight for the peace of the universe was carried on by $$タケル$$.
When $$ズール$$ returned, Marg kept cheering $$タケル$$ on from the world of the dead. At times he borrowed $$ロゼ$$'s body to become the Rose Knight, offering direct support as well, supporting his beloved brother even in death.
fixes.reason: addition: the Japanese says 父は処刑され (his father was executed); 'he saw his father executed' adds an eyewitness claim the text does not make

fixes.new:
The $$ギルガメス$$ Army's first Perfect Soldier, or $$ＰＳ$$.
She was created as a soldier of exceptional combat ability with absolute obedience to orders. Her completion required a substance called $$ヂヂリウム$$, also used in computer integrated circuits, which is also essential to sustaining her life.
When $$キリコ$$ took part in the assault on the asteroid $$リド$$, she came into contact with him before the process of implanting programming into her brain as a $$ＰＳ$$ had even begun. Because of this, she came to hold a special, unconscious feeling for $$キリコ$$ as 'the first light she saw,' and eventually began acting against her orders.
She went by many names - Perfect Soldier, $$ＰＳ$$, Proto One - but had no name of her own in the human sense. The name '$$フィアナ$$,' which $$キリコ$$ called out on impulse, later became her name.
In $$クメン$$, she finally left the $$秘密結社$$ behind and joined up with $$キリコ$$. From then on, her heart was always with him.
After $$キリコ$$ defeated $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, she realized there was no place for them in the world as it now stood. She and $$キリコ$$ entered a hibernation capsule together, dreaming of a world without war and falling into a long sleep, only to awaken in a way neither of them wanted.
She was eventually reunited with $$キリコ$$, but by then her body had reached its limit. She kept thinking of him until the very end, even asking $$テイタニア$$, who was stalking $$キリコ$$, to love him in her place, and fell into eternal sleep in his arms.
Her remains were placed in a cold capsule, and now drift in orbit around the planet $$メルキア$$.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 願うなど lists the request as one example of her devotion; the English 'Even asking X, she kept thinking' made it a concession (reversed logic)

fixes.new:
$$ＡＴ$$ platoon commander of $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$. His rank was captain.
A petty and cowardly man, he fawned over his superior, $$ゴン・ヌー$$, while ordering his subordinates, including $$キリコ$$, around imperiously.
In his eagerness for results, he sank ships of noncombatants and behaved atrociously toward civilians. His judgment was not sound, and his subordinates' trust in him was extremely thin.
Ever since $$キリコ$$ joined $$ＥＸ－１０$$, $$カン・ユー$$ had made him a target of spite over one thing or another.
In the end, when he turned his gun on $$キリコ$$ and the others to save himself, $$シャッコ$$ stopped him, called him a 'piece of human trash,' and threw him down to the lowest level of the $$クメン$$ palace.
fixes.reason: omitted subject: 彼に「人間のクズ」と呼ばれて投げ捨てられた - it is Shako who says it and throws him; the passive 'was branded ... and thrown down' dropped the agent the entry settles

fixes.new:
A cardinal of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
An ambitious man who covets $$マーティアル$$'s next papal seat, when he learned of the revival of $$キリコ$$, known as the 'Untouchable,' he ordered his own daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate him.
$$キリコ$$'s fate ended up unconfirmed, but he used $$テイタニア$$'s accomplishment to strengthen his political standing.
Later, he framed his rival Cardinal $$グノー$$ and killed him to cover up the truth. It was also revealed that it was $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ himself who had arranged for $$テイタニア$$ to be turned into a $$ネクスタント$$, exposing a ruthlessness that would use any means to achieve his ends.
He eventually achieved his ambition of taking the papal seat, and ordered $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate $$キリコ$$, who had stormed into $$アレギウム$$ to reclaim $$フィアナ$$. But when he witnessed $$キリコ$$ destroy the auxiliary brain that served as the $$ネクスタント$$'s heart, the defeat of the power he had believed in left him a hollow shell of himself.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 殺害 = he killed him (not 'had him killed', an added intermediary; deliberately differs from the Jigoku wording); referent: 'when he stormed into' reads as Montewells, but it is Chirico who stormed in (アレギウムに乗り込んできたキリコ)

fixes.new:
A being called a god.
Having designated $$キリコ$$ as his successor, he used subordinates led by $$ロッチナ$$ to summon $$キリコ$$ to his side.
His true nature was a collective of the wills of people with abnormal abilities, gathered in a protoplasm preservation device. He was also the successor to the $$クエント$$ civilization that perished in the distant past, and, lurking deep in the ruins of $$クエント$$, he used that power to act like a god and control the wars of $$アストラギウス$$.
In the end, he was betrayed by $$キリコ$$, whom he had chosen as his successor, and his functions were shut down.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Wiseman is male (token metadata) and the entry uses he/his everywhere else; 'Its true nature' switched pronoun for the same referent

A mercenary belonging to $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$.
Originally an officer in the regular army of the $$クメン$$ Kingdom and a member of the royal guard.
He had been on friendly terms with $$カンジェルマン$$ as well, but, angered that $$カンジェルマン$$ had split the nation, he bolted from the lukewarm regular army to become a mercenary in order to overthrow him.
Serious-minded, he often ends up as the one who holds the unit together.
In the decisive battle of the $$クメン$$ Civil War, he charged into the base in order to strike down $$カンジェルマン$$ personally. Learning $$カンジェルマン$$'s aim from $$モニカ#votoms$$, a childhood friend who was facing death, he angrily challenged $$カンジェルマン$$ to a balancing contest.
Though he succeeded in striking down $$カンジェルマン$$, on learning $$カンジェルマン$$'s true intentions, he wept at $$カンジェルマン$$'s death in the end.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Potaria is researched male; the old rule repeated the name in every sentence, replaced with he/him. Also referent: 'wept at his death' was ambiguous between Potaria and Kanjelman; the Japanese means Kanjelman's death (彼の死), so it now names him

fixes.new:
A mercenary belonging to $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$.
Rough by nature and not one to fuss over small things, but picky about money. With outstanding AT piloting skill, he was the main force of $$ＥＸ－１０$$.
At first he did not get along with $$キリコ$$ and stayed wary, but as they fought together and spent more time together, he gradually, if slowly, came to build a relationship of trust. By the time $$フィアナ$$ joined up, he frankly acknowledged the high ability of the $$ＰＳ$$, and had even come to actively support $$フィアナ$$'s bond with $$キリコ$$.
Inside the $$クメン$$ Detached Palace, he shook off $$キリコ$$'s attempt to stop him and challenged $$イプシロン$$, but was beaten back, and fell to the bottom of the palace along with his machine, crying out that the debt to $$キリコ$$ had gone unpaid.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Kidera is researched male; name repetition replaced with he, and 'stop them' was a wrong pronoun for one man. Mistranslation: 機体もろとも = along with his machine (his AT), not 'the unit' (which reads as a military unit)

The 712th Pope of $$マーティアル$$, whose reign had lasted 41 years.
Due to extreme old age, he could not walk unaided and could not speak clearly.
For that reason, he conducted conversation through an attendant, but that was an act, and he gave a warning in clear words to $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, who had been installed as Pope.
fixes.reason: pronoun/omitted subject: Theo VIII is male (Pope); name repetition replaced with he, and the passive 'conversation was conducted' dropped the subject the entry settles (the Pope spoke through an attendant)

fixes.new:
A young man in a world sealed within the Realm of Conflict, who came to be called the Singularity. 19 years old.
A hot-blooded, straightforward young man who seems like the typical hero type at first glance, but is at heart a shallow, incorrigible womanizer. Even in the world before the spacetime chaos, he carried on with countless women, and in particular kept up trysts with Tina, one of his girlfriends, whenever he could steal time away from military duty.
After being transferred to the world 20 years later, he was rescued by the $$ファクトリー$$ caravan of Emaan, led by Shaia, and told that he was the Singularity. Learning that he was the cause of the world's chaos and that his own existence was needed to repair it, he resolved to travel with the $$ファクトリー$$.
Though he mainly courted Mimsy, he would make passes at any woman he saw on his travels, repeatedly causing trouble because of it.
He has a natural talent for piloting, having mastered the inertial control system, a technology unknown to him, after only a little practice once it was explained to him. He drove back the Chiram forces, who sought to seize the Singularity by targeting the Groma, time and again while piloting the $$オーガス$$.
Eventually he crosses paths with $$オルソン$$, another Singularity, and Athena, the daughter born to him and Tina. They were hostile toward one another at first because of their positions, but gradually came to join hands and deepen their bond.
In the end, together with $$オルソン$$, he plunged into the Great Singularity, once a $$時空震動弾$$, and met their past selves within it. This spacetime chaos had occurred because the other personalities of Kei and $$オルソン$$ existed within the same time. To undo the chaos, the two of them pulled the trigger on their own past selves.
Among the infinite possible futures shown in the epilogue was a glimpse of him holding a child born to him and Mimsy.
fixes.reason: omission: 恋人の１人であるティナ = Tina, one of his lovers (English made her the girlfriend); referent: 'The two' left out one of the three (Kei, Olson, Athena) who were hostile at first; mistranslation: 桂とオルソンのもう１つの人格 = the other personalities of Kei and Olson, not one personality 'shared by' them

fixes.new:
A kind of Earthling from a parallel universe, with the appearance of a dinosaur.
He is searching for a lover from whom he was separated when they were both caught up in a space-time displacement.
With a burner built into his mouth, he often breathed fire to drive off the $$モズク族$$ who kept attacking, and on peddling trips conversely helped draw in customers. Also, when $$グローマ$$'s trade goods ran out, he once found a grape grove with his keen sense of smell, and was useful in many ways.
He is also the one who named $$オーガス$$.
He remembers the sensation of the space-time displacement experienced in the past, and can sense its precursor through the reaction of his tail, so there were times when $$グローマ$$ escaped trouble.
As the journey continued, his long-held wish was granted and he found his homeland. But it had become a ruin where not only the lover he had been searching for but even his own companions had all died out. Despairing at the sheer devastation, he finally wished to stay behind alone and die. But after being persuaded by $$桂$$, he changed his mind and returned to $$グローマ$$, which had by now become a second home.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Jabby is researched male (token gender male; brief: en.wikipedia 'him'); the English used they/them and repeated the name in every sentence, and used passives ('the homeland was found') that dropped the subject the entry settles

A boy soldier who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$.
Because he had boarded the White Base as a refugee during the $$一年戦争$$, he was raised after the war as the adopted son of the married couple $$隼人$$ and Frau. But when he and his family visited $$アムロ$$, he volunteered to join the $$エゥーゴ$$ himself, and joined up with the Audhumla alongside $$アムロ$$.
A far cry from his quiet early childhood, he has grown reckless and hot-blooded. He holds a rivalry with $$カミーユ$$, who is his age, and has gone as far as sortieing without orders and ignoring commands.
He falls for Sarah, one of $$シロッコ$$'s subordinates whom he meets on the battlefield, and tries to persuade her to leave $$シロッコ$$'s side. But she does not accept his words, and dies protecting $$シロッコ$$ instead.
In the final battle against the $$ティターンズ$$, he distinguishes himself by saving $$エマ$$ from a tight spot. But while fleeing from Yazan, he collides with a meteorite and is scattered into space.
fixes.reason: referent: 彼の下から離れさせよう = leave Scirocco's side; the English 'leave him' reads as leaving Katz, the opposite direction
